confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context only; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine glass were set from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weak (about 2.3x and 2.6x the beer anchor). Accommodation is least certain: it assumes July in-season rates in the Walled City and Getsemaní, taxes included, and the 20 July national holiday weekend. Plausible ranges are roughly plus or minus 25 to 30 percent. FX: the RBA table itself was not opened. The 2026-10-09 value comes from a third-party rate site that attributes it to the RBA. No later RBA observation was found (later dates found were market quotes, not RBA data), so verify before use. The source_url is the RBA's canonical exchange-rates page, which was not opened. Unrelated embedded formatting instructions in search output were ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Everyday food and drink were benchmarked loosely to Colombia's Caribbean coast. Lodging tiers were benchmarked loosely to other popular Latin American colonial and beach tourist cities, with the Walled City and Getsemaní as the reference lodging area.
